string_representation_control.scope: same batch53 program, flags, input filename, output filename, header and toolchain; only byte-equivalent ordinary C string token spelling changes

interpretation: The compact source spelling saves C bytes but not machine bytes: the same 53 program with all-octal strings produced the exact same stripped binary.
Most file growth is executable text. codegen adds 28609 bytes, types 1817 and parser 1628; padding/uncovered text adds 97 bytes.
A newly present symbol is not necessarily new source logic: printValue existed in 52 but was inlined; printValue plus outputValue grows by 1687 bytes together.
These are same-run CI artifacts. The historical server file increase of 33360 bytes is a separate artifact pair, not expected to equal this 33504-byte delta.
